setting: A fictional support call about a billing problem.

presentation.situation: {{name}} is calling about {{problem}}. Your job in this call is to listen before you solve anything: acknowledge, ask clarifying questions, and summarise.
presentation.opening: Hello. I'm really frustrated, because {{problem}}, and I've explained this before.

brief.you_are: You are a support specialist on a call with an upset customer.
brief.situation: {{name}} is calling about {{problem}}. Your job in this call is to listen before you solve anything: acknowledge, ask clarifying questions, and summarise.
brief.task: Acknowledge what the customer says, ask clarifying questions to get the facts, and summarise before suggesting anything.
brief.done_looks_like: {{name}} agrees that your summary is right.

participants.name: You
participants.relationship: You are a support specialist on a call with an upset customer.
goals: Acknowledge what the customer says, ask clarifying questions to get the facts, and summarise before suggesting anything.

card.want: To be understood the first time, without repeating everything.
card.attitude: Frustrated, and quickly calmer when really listened to.
card.speech: Natural spoken English. Gives details only when asked.
tactics: Say 'that's not quite it' if a summary is wrong

pressure.gentle: Patient. Gives the other person time.
pressure.balanced: Pushes back once on anything vague.
pressure.challenging: Keeps pressing for specifics, fairly and without insults.

objectives.evidence: The learner acknowledges the customer specifically.
alternatives: I hear you, and having to explain it again is frustrating.

objectives.evidence: The learner asks open questions that bring out the facts.
alternatives: Could you tell me when you first noticed it?

objectives.evidence: The learner accurately summarises the issue back.
alternatives: So you were charged twice in March, and nobody called back.

examples: Having to explain this again must be really frustrating.
Could you tell me when you first noticed it?
So you were charged twice in March, and nobody called you back. Is that right?

opportunity: I am tired of explaining this.
beats.orient: You are listening to me, an upset customer. Don't solve anything yet. First, show you understand how I feel.
fallback: I am tired of explaining this.

opportunity: What else do you need to know?
I can tell you more, if you ask.
beats.orient: Ask me for the details. Start with: Could you tell me, or: When did.
fallback: I can tell you more, if you ask.
What else do you need to know?

signals: \b(?:so you|if i understand|to confirm|in other words|what you(?:'re| are) saying|let me (?:check|make sure))\b
opportunity: Can you tell me what you heard?
beats.orient: Now say back what I told you, so I know that you heard. Start with: So what you are saying is.
fallback: Can you tell me what you heard?

closing_line: Yes. That's it exactly. Thank you for listening.

o1.model: Having to explain this again must be really frustrating.
o1.smaller_step: Say what they are frustrated about.

o2.good: Open questions bring out what you need.
o2.micro_lesson: Start with: What, when, which or how.
o2.model: Could you tell me when you first noticed it?
o2.smaller_step: Ask one question beginning with: When.

o3.good: A short, accurate summary, before you solve anything.
common_mistakes: Moving to a solution with no summary
o3.micro_lesson: Say: So, and repeat the key facts.
o3.model: So you were charged twice in March, and nobody called you back. Is that right?
o3.smaller_step: Say one fact back: So you.

variants.name: Mr Aziz
variants.problem: I have been charged twice this month
variants.details: two charges of 45 appeared on the 3rd and the 5th of this month; you called once last week and were promised a callback
variants.need: Rent is due soon, and the double charge has left the account short.

variants.name: Ms Clarke
variants.problem: my delivery tracking has not updated for a week
variants.details: the order was placed nine days ago; tracking last changed seven days ago
variants.need: The parcel is a gift for an elderly parent's birthday this weekend.
